newsitem.title: CUBA: Cuban parliament to hold session later in October.
newsitem.headline: Cuban parliament to hold session later in October.

text.p: Cuba's National Assembly, which meets twice a year for two or three days, is to hold its first session of the year later this month, official media said on Thursday.
The ruling Communist Party newspaper Granma published a statement by parliament president Ricardo Alarcon saying the session would begin on October 25.
There was no indication what parliament would debate, although the focus is generally on economic measures.
